name: Unified Data Portal (DataHub)
tagline: Centralized Integration, Automated Data Cleaning, and Sectoral Cataloging Portal.

data.title: Building the Foundation for Data-Driven Policy
data.description: An Enterprise Data Management System that solves fragmentation and dirty data issues across departments. DataHub automatically cleans, validates, and catalogs regional data into a smart central information hub ready for search and audit.

features.title: Automated Data Cleaning
features.desc: A smart engine that automatically tidies raw uploaded data by standardizing formats, normalizing naming, and ensuring data type consistency.

features.title: Advanced Search & Smart Filtering
features.desc: Advanced retrieval capabilities with multi-layered filters (year, sector, format). Find specific dataset intersections in seconds.

features.title: Comprehensive Audit Trail
features.desc: A centralized audit system recording every modification. Ensures full accountability by tracking cleaning history and the original source of every figure.

features.title: Validation & Quality Score
features.desc: Algorithms that detect outliers and missing values, providing an objective feasibility score before data distribution.

data.title: Why is DataHub Crucial?
data.subtitle: Transforming Data Swamps into Structured Assets

items.title: Single Source of Truth
items.desc: Eliminates confusion from version differences between agencies. All leaders refer to a single validated dataset.

items.title: Ready for Advanced Analytics
items.desc: Clean, structured data is a prerequisite before adopting AI or Big Data Analytics technologies in the future.

items.title: Guaranteed Data Integrity
items.desc: Multi-level validation processes and transparent audit trails minimize the risk of sectoral data manipulation.

items.q: How does the system perform Data Cleaning automatically?
items.a: The system uses a rule-based engine that scans Excel/CSV files upon upload. The engine removes extra spaces, standardizes date formats, and detects empty cells before saving to the main database.

items.q: What is the purpose of Advanced Search and Filtering?
items.a: These features allow analysts or leaders to filter data specifically—for example, searching for 'Maternal Health Data' for 'District A' in '2023'—eliminating the need to manually browse dozens of files.

items.q: How does the Audit Trail system work?
items.a: The Audit Trail is a background process. it records the user ID, upload timestamp, column modification history, and validation status, ensuring data authenticity can be verified at any time.
